definition: Enables the transfer of a UDP-N-acetylglucosamine from one side of a membrane to the other. N-acetylglucosamine is a substance composed of N-acetylglucosamine, a common structural unit of oligosaccharides, in glycosidic linkage with uridine diphosphate.
label: SLC35B4 mediates the transport of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine into the Golgi lumen
